parsed.name: 数字万用表校准系统
parsed.description: 用于数字万用表校准与核查的实验室测试系统，通常由待校万用表、已校准的参考万用表以及电源或激励源组成，用于施加已知电信号并比较测量结果，从而完成校准和精度检查。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory test system for calibrating and verifying digital multimeters. It typically consists of the multimeter under test, a calibrated reference multimeter, and a power supply or stimulus source used to apply known electrical signals and compare readings for calibration and accuracy checks.

actions.description: 初始化万用表校准系统的操作界面
actions.description_en: Initialize the operating interface for the multimeter calibration system.
Connect the multimeter that will be calibrated.

actions.description: 连接已校准的参考万用表
连接用于提供校准信号的电源
actions.description_en: Connect the power supply used to provide calibration signals.
